e95c7a33298edc28.name: Severe hypoglycemia exclusion
e95c7a33298edc28.rationale: Standard exclusion for insulin-titration studies; ADA recommends excluding patients with recent severe hypoglycemia.
e95c7a33298edc28.regulatory_reference: ADA Hypoglycemia Classification 2023; FDA Guidance for T2DM trials

e95c7a33298edc28.name: HbA1c upper bound exclusion
e95c7a33298edc28.rationale: Patients with HbA1c >10.5% typically require rapid intervention beyond what a comparative trial can safely provide.

e95c7a33298edc28.name: Bariatric surgery exclusion
e95c7a33298edc28.rationale: Bariatric procedures cause substantial changes in insulin sensitivity and gut hormones, confounding T2DM trial outcomes. Commonly omitted in first drafts.

e95c7a33298edc28.name: Minimum T2DM duration
e95c7a33298edc28.rationale: Phase III trials of glucose-lowering agents typically require ≥6 months since T2DM diagnosis to ensure a stable disease phenotype.

e95c7a33298edc28.name: Renal function inclusion
e95c7a33298edc28.rationale: Renal function eligibility is required; eGFR ≥45 mL/min is the common threshold for insulin studies.

e95c7a33298edc28.name: Hypoglycemia adjudication committee
e95c7a33298edc28.rationale: Standard for insulin studies; blinded adjudication of hypoglycemic events strengthens primary endpoint reliability.
e95c7a33298edc28.regulatory_reference: FDA Guidance for industry: Diabetes Mellitus Endpoint Adjudication

e95c7a33298edc28.name: Contraception Requirements for Women of Childbearing Potential (WOCBP)
e95c7a33298edc28.rationale: Regulatory guidelines require clear contraception requirements to minimize fetal risk in clinical trials involving investigational drugs, especially in chronic conditions like T2DM.
e95c7a33298edc28.draft_topic: Contraception use and pregnancy avoidance requirements for WOCBP
e95c7a33298edc28.regulatory_reference: ICH E6(R2), FDA Guidance for Industry: Considerations for Inclusion of Women in Clinical Trials

e95c7a33298edc28.name: Prohibited Medications During the Study
e95c7a33298edc28.rationale: To ensure data integrity and patient safety, protocols must specify medications that are not allowed during the trial that could confound efficacy or safety assessments.
e95c7a33298edc28.draft_topic: List of prohibited concomitant medications and therapies
e95c7a33298edc28.regulatory_reference: FDA Guidance for Industry: Diabetes Mellitus — Developing Drugs and Therapeutic Biologics for Treatment and Prevention
